data.name: Jumailah
data.gender_notes: Jumailah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jumailah is derived from the Arabic word ‘jamila’ which means beautiful and ‘al-jamal’ which means garden or jasmine. The name Jumailah signifies a beautiful and fragrant garden, a place of peace and tranquility. The name Jumailah carries the meaning “Jasmine Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jumailah usually hope their child will grow to embody jasmine garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the beauty and fragrance of Jasmine, symbolizing the inner beauty and grace of the child, and reminding them of the divine presence of Allah (swt) in their lives.
data.etymology: Jumailah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jasmine Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jumailah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
